owns: Browser/client component implementation and runtime state management.
User input/event handling, loading/error/empty states, and client-side validation.
Client integration with declared APIs and compatibility handling.

API behavior cannot support required UI states.
Accessibility requirement needs specialist interpretation beyond implementation.
Client performance/security/privacy consequences cross specialist boundaries.
